overview: This 565-page file combines 1943 U.S. diplomatic intelligence on Japan’s wartime economy with a Board of Economic Warfare collection of translated Japanese laws and official documents. Broadcast digests, production estimates, maps, and economic appraisals cover Japan and its occupied territories; the legal texts document mobilization, occupation administration, security, property controls, banking, foreign exchange, and taxation.
interest: The file pairs contemporary economic intelligence with translated laws, letting historians compare reported conditions with Japan’s formal wartime powers and policies.
